messages:
nick_support: Quick escalate - tenant 'acme-zen' stuck at final provisioning step. 503 then bursts of 429. Partner demo 15:30 PT. Adding @sara_cs @kai_am

sara_cs: On it. Is this write-only? Any read impacts?

nick_support: Only writes. Logs:
`````
POST /tenants/acme-zen/provision -> 503 backend_busy
then 429 tenant_rate_limit
`````

kai_am: I'll handle renewal comms. Need ETA and a fallback. Please confirm preview possible.

lina_eng: Investigating. Early clue: autoscaler misread policy name; will patch and scale +2 nodes. ETA 25m.

sara_cs: Customer-facing plan: 1) Transparent ETA 25-35m, 2) Offer read-only preview link, 3) Post-demo follow-up + renewal invite, 4) Offer workaround doc. Approved?

kai_am: Approved. I'll draft the renewal reassurance blurb.

lina_eng: Patch applied and pool scaled. Command: kubectl patch autoscaler config + scale gpu-pool. Monitoring. ETA 12m to stabilize.

nick_support: Enabled preview flag:
`````
/feature-flag enable acme-zen provisioning_preview=true
`````
Preview URL shared with customer.

deploy-bot: autoscaler alert resolved - owners: lina_eng, nick_support

lina_eng: Provisioning retries now succeed. Verified tenant onboarding completed.

sara_cs: Great. I'll run the demo with the preview, send post-demo summary and set renewal prep call. Thanks all :pray:
